pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: You are designing a notification delivery system for a large consumer app with 50 million active users. The system needs to send push notifications, emails, and in-app alerts — sometimes all three for the same event. Notifications can be triggered by user actions, scheduled campaigns, and automated backend events. Walk through how you would design this system: what are the main components, how do you handle reliability (making sure notifications actually get delivered), how do you avoid sending duplicate notifications, and how would you scale the system to handle a sudden 10x spike in notification volume?
